children: Shares of Concord Biotech are in focus on Monday, September 21 as the company said its board of directors will meet this week to consider bonus issue proposal.

The company, in an exchange filing on Saturday, September 19, said its board of directors is scheduled to meet on Wednesday, September 23, to consider the proposal to declare bonus equity shares to the existing shareholders of the firm.
The same is in accordance with the applicable provisions and is subject to approval of the company's shareholders.
This will be the first instance that Concord Biotech will be issuing bonus shares to its shareholders, as per data available on the exchanges.
At the end of the June quarter, promoter entities held 44.08% stake in the company, while public shareholders held 55.92% stake, as per stock exchange data.

Among the public shareholders, multiple Jhunjhunwala family trusts holds a total of 24.09% stake in the company — The Aryavir Jhunjhunwala Discretionary Trust, Aryaman Jhunjhunwala Discretionary Trust and Nishtha Jhunjhunwala Discretionary Trust hold 8.03% stake each in the company, respectively.
Close to 79,000 small retail shareholders, or those with authorized share capital of up to ₹2 lakh, had a 7.03% stake in the company at the end of the June quarter.

Concord Biotech reported its first quarter earnings on July 31. Its net profit increased 32.8% to ₹58.5 crore from ₹44.05 crore last year. Its revenue increased 26.2% to ₹257.4 crore from ₹2024 crore.
The company's earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) increased 34.2% to ₹82.4 crore from ₹61.3 crore and its margin expanded to 32% from 30.1% in the year-ago period.

Shares of Concord Biotech ended the previous session 2.7% up at ₹1,500 apiece. The stock has declined 4.5% in the past month but is up 12.3% this year, so far. The stock had made its debut back in August 2023, and has since more than doubled from its issue price of ₹741 per share.

title: Bonus Alert: Stock with significant Jhunjhunwala family stake set to reward shareholders
